crumbs.title: Get started in your ads account

runs: For ads accounts that pay by credit card, >x< uses automatic billing. We charge your primary payment method when you reach a spend threshold. We also charge periodically for any remaining costs. If your primary payment method fails and you have additional payment methods set up, we will charge them.

When you reach a spend threshold, a “Pay Now” button will appear on the “Billing” tab and you can use it to immediately pay your outstanding balance instead of waiting for the next automatic billing cycle.

You can access your invoices in the "Billing" tab of your ads account. You'll be issued an invoice once per billing cycle or when you use the “Pay Now” feature. Past invoices cannot be modified and we cannot re-issue invoices, but future invoices will reflect any updated information.
Invoice number: this is a unique ID for your invoice to help you identify and manage your billing
Date of issue: date the invoice was issued to you
Description: a short description of the ads product purchased (i.e., promoted ads)
VAT or tax amount: this is subject to your location's tax rates
Total including VAT: the total charged for the billing period
